Why should you learn from us

Little Star Mandarin School has been teaching a lot of young kids and we are able to design our courses according your needs no matter what your level is. Our program is fun, short and sweet and you will learn in a relaxed environment.

We use a lot of games to help you memorize Chinese characters and practice them in daily conversations.

Courses and Programs

We offer a variety of courses and programs for young kids, from beginners to advanced learners, that are designed to suit their needs and interests.

Mandarin for Beginners

Friendly classes for children starting with Chinese sounds, words, and characters.

Long-Term Learning

Structured lessons for steady progress, confidence, and daily conversation practice.

Culture Programs

Chinese culture activities for schools, groups, and extra-curriculum programs.
